text: 创业板指、科创50指数均跌超2%，沪指跌0.81%，深成指跌1.68%，算力硬件、军工、消费电子、半导体等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超4400只
text_en: ChiNext Index and STAR 50 Index both fall over 2%, Shanghai Composite down 0.81%, Shenzhen Component down 1.68%, with computing power hardware, defense, consumer electronics, semiconductors among the biggest decliners; over 4,400 stocks fell across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
